name: Kellogg's Rice Krispies Treats Original Marshmallow Square
whyItWorks: Combines toasted puffed white rice cereal with melted marshmallows and a small amount of butter. The puffed rice has virtually zero insoluble fiber and the marshmallow base is soft, chewable, and comforting.
prepOrOrderInstructions: A fantastic on-the-go snack or lunchbox dessert when you need quick energy without digestive irritation.
watchOuts: Contains a tiny amount of milk whey in the butter flavor; safe for almost all lactose intolerances.
